evaluation: non-overlapping chronological intervals with whole clusters and boundary-cluster exclusion
conservative series-superset clusters with collision audit
validation calibration bins and pooled proper scores
regional and patch transfer slices with training-support checks
separate complete and imputed-row proper scores with imputed-only blockers
fold-local equal-side imputation with signed missingness and support indicators
minimum and per-metric support diagnostics with named missing features

estimands.future_player_value: Development-only marginal map-win logit contribution for one player in the next eligible map, using strictly prior form, role, champion-role atoms, and explicit support diagnostics.
estimands.future_team_value: Development-only exact-five roster map-win logit difference before the next eligible map. It uses roster player-form aggregates, prior team win state, and roster continuity.

fit_contract.metric_weights: fit inside development folds; no hand-assigned performance weights
fit_contract.missing_values: fit one fold-local median per side-level feature and apply it equally to blue and red; allow neutral zero only for all-missing centered atom coordinates and fail closed otherwise
fit_contract.optimizer: require finite converged zero-intercept L-BFGS evidence for every nested candidate and final fold fit
fit_contract.player_state: strictly prior time-decayed form with fold-local rank-3 atoms and support diagnostics
fit_contract.regularization: select L2 strength inside each outer training fold with a nested chronological whole-series log-loss comparison
fit_contract.representation: atom-derived rank-3 champion embedding refit inside each chronological fold
fit_contract.role_identity: normalize top, jungle, mid, bot, and support aliases before every atom fit and transform lookup
fit_contract.side_symmetry: zero-intercept linear logit over blue-minus-red features after equal fold-local side imputation
fit_contract.team_state: exact-five roster aggregation plus strictly prior team win state and roster continuity

information_boundary.current_checkpoint_targets: target only; forbidden from the same map pregame vector
information_boundary.current_final_metrics: update future history only after the map
information_boundary.future_rows: forbidden from baselines, embeddings, loadings, and hyperparameter selection
information_boundary.same_timestamp_maps: independent batch; updates become available after the full timestamp block

descriptive_player_rating_protocol.relationship: The future-value model extends the deferred atom direction. It does not replace or amend the descriptive v6 rating.
